inlines.v: AP'PLE, noun 1. The fruit of the apple tree, [pyrus malus, ] from which cider is made. 2. The apple of the eye is the pupil. Apple of love, or love apple the tomato, or lycopersicum, a species of Solanum. The stalk is herbaceous, with oval, pinnated leaves, and small yellow flowers. The berry is smooth, soft, of a yellow or reddish color, of the size of a plum. It is used in soups and broths. AP'PLE, verb transitive To form like an apple
